questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ledte primært efter en destination, hvor undervisningen foregik på engelsk men med mulighed for også at øve mit franske - derfor Montreal.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Hvis man overvejer det, skal man give det et forsøg!

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: McGill har en fin hjemmeside, men man skulle stadigt selv opsøge meget information. Det hjælper at få kontakt med andre danskere i byen.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: De øvrige danskere fra KU.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Informationen var fin men processen er generelt lidt forvirrende.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Jeg brugte facebook grupper, hvor jeg kontakte en masse og endte med at finde et privat hus.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det er en fed måde at blive mere lokal i byen! Men man skal være meget på og snakke meget engelsk.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Informationen om housing fra McGill havde en del mangler, men facebook er et godt sted at starte.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man får sendt information på email og kan rimeligt nemt følge trinene ud fra dette. Men man skal være hurtig, for mange fag bliver hurtigt bookede.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Jeg sendte email til universitet, hvis noget var forvirrende.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg var ikke helt sikker på, hvilke fag jeg ønskede mig, men jeg oplevede, at mange fag var bookede, da jeg ville søge dem. Heldigvis fik jeg stadigt relevante fag, og det er nemt at droppe et fag og tilføje et nyt i starten af semesteret.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Undersøg fagene i god tid, sørg for at have en række back-up fag, og søg fagene så snart registreringen åbner.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg havde to BA fag og to MA fag, fordi de var mest relevante, men niveauet var egentligt fint. Arbejdsbyrden er dog generelt stor på McGill.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Generelt meget det samme med forelæsninger, øvelser og læsning. Men der er flere deadlines undervejs med afleveringer og midterms.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
MIMM 324 Fundamental Virology 
COMS 330 Media in Cultural life/Critical perspective on AI and Data Justice
EXSU 500 AI in Medicine
PPHS 528 Economic Evaluation of Health Programs

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Noget man finder spændende! Og ikke være bange for de høje tal på kurserne, så længe man ikke har noget imod lidt arbejde i løbet af semesteret.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Jeg brugte mange penge på dyre flybilletter og på udflugter i Canada.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Min boligsituation var meget billigere end de fleste andre (800 CAD/month), mens mad og fly var dyre, end jeg havde regnet med.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg gjorde ikke brug heraf.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Jeg deltog ikke.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Tag på en masse udflugter med andre udvekslingsstuderende, gerne ikke bare de danske!

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Quebec City, Toronto, Niagara Falls samt at tage på vandreture.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Folk var meget venlige, men ift de lokale kommer man langt ved at prøve med bare lidt franske gloser.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Snak med folk til undervisningen og opsøg selv kontakten. Folk vil rigtigt gerne høre om Danmark, og hvad du synes om deres sted.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Byen var meget mere fransk, end jeg havde regnet med.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Jeg gjorde meget brug af cafe-kulturen og naturen.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Vær forberedt på at skulle lægge noget energi i studiet, hvis du ikke kun tager introduktionsfag.
Vær opsøgende i kontakt med lokale og andre udvekslingsstuderende. 
Nyd Canada så meget som muligt.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Det er en rigtigt god by at være udvekslingsstuderende i.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Jeg elskede at studere på campus og udnyttede meget faciliteterne der til at studere sammen med andre og alene. Kaffe er billigt, så udnyt det imens. Gør ting som du ikke normalt ville gøre.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Man er langt væk hjemmefra, hvis der sker ting derhjemme imens.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
